catalogue_review.review_depth: Publisher metadata, licence and selected methods checked.
catalogue_review.measurement_context: Game validation followed by compassion versus memory training; outcome is helping in the Zurich Prosocial Game. Training assignment depended on participant timing and available slots, not randomization.
limitations: Short follow-up and female-only sample; game helping does not establish durable everyday behaviour.
Allocation, attrition and cohort overlap require full appraisal.
catalogue_review.sample_reported: Experiment 1: 68; Experiment 2: 69 entered, 60 completed, one missing-game exclusion.

records.note: Compassion and prosocial measurement discovery lead; appraisal pending.
limits: Not accepted as independent BQ evidence.

catalogue_review.review_depth: Author-hosted original paper and selected supplemental methods checked.
catalogue_review.measurement_context: Eight-week mindfulness or compassion training versus wait-list; observed outcome is offering a seat to a confederate presenting discomfort. Confederates were blind to condition and hypothesis.
limitations: Wait-list does not match instructor contact or class participation.
One staged encounter; attrition and exclusions constrain generalization.
catalogue_review.sample_reported: 67 initially recruited; 26 dropped out and two excluded; 39 final participants.

records.title: Effects of compassion meditation on a psychological model of charitable donation
records.rights: Bibliographic metadata, links and original notes only; dataset reuse permissions unverified.
records.note: Compassion and prosocial measurement discovery lead; appraisal pending.
limits: Not accepted as independent BQ evidence.

catalogue_review.review_depth: PubMed metadata plus author-hosted paper selected methods and results checked.
catalogue_review.measurement_context: Two studies: donation-model development and a four-week trial versus placebo oxytocin and familiarity training. Donation choices use real experimental earnings. Results qualify the abstract: donation change differs from familiarity and pooled controls, but not placebo oxytocin alone; familiarity donations decrease while compassion changes are nonsignificant.
limitations: Post-intervention assessors were not blind; full risk-of-bias appraisal pending.
Later imaging reports may reuse this cohort; no additional independent study inferred.
catalogue_review.sample_reported: Study 2: 58 randomized; one donation-task exclusion reported.
